texture_overrides_note: Straight mono-terminal preset with two deliberate texture overrides. halation goes 0.0 -> 0.04 so the matrix-green (#37F712, ~13.6:1 on the #0A0A0A canvas) blooms faintly on the two emphasize beats and the WOW halation check passes; the bloom stays tiny so the screen still reads as a clean console, not neon. lighting_arc goes 0.18 -> 0.22 to clear the WOW color-drift floor (>=0.20) and give the runtime a subtle time-of-day push without breaking the flat black canvas. Everything else is the preset verbatim: JetBrains Mono throughout at 600/400, lowercase case rule, hard cut motion (scene_in 0.06, scene_out 0.05) for terminal snap, square corners (stage_radius 0), 1px rules, grain 0.05 and vignette 0.22 for the faint CRT tooth. Audio palette electronic to match the Voxel Revolution bed. Framework MANIFESTO: title -> flash -> terminal -> fix -> flash -> close, the canonical color-burst arc with one terminal hero inserted so the install ritual carries a non-text beat.
